A line-break-only emphasis inside a table cell still separates the words on either side

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<table><tr><td><strong>Alpha</strong><em><br></em>Beta</td></tr></table>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
